They claim that we are corrupt and deliberately missmanaging the current crisis due to personal interests instead of doing what is best for the country. They also claim we are unwilling to give more power to parliament and that we have shown that peaceful reform is not a possibility. We cannot send in the army to deal with the protestors due to a fear of such an act confirming their claims of despotism. Spies planted within the protests do however report that the protests are likely to turn into a fullscale revolution soon.

However, Lotharingia is a mighty nation and we will not give in to the demands of these rebels! We will march into the Rhineland and root them out of their homes and forts! One Kingdom, indivisible!
